name: @pipeworx/mcp-csv

tools.name: csv_to_json
tools.description: Parse RFC 4180 CSV into JSON (keyless, offline). With `header` true (default) the first row becomes object keys; otherwise rows are returned as arrays. Handles quoted fields, escaped quotes, and embedded commas/newlines. Set `delimiter` for TSV etc.

header.description: Treat the first row as a header (default true).

tools.name: json_to_csv
tools.description: Serialize an array of JSON objects (or arrays) to CSV (keyless, offline). Object keys become the header (union of all keys, in first-seen order). Fields are quoted when needed.

rows.description: An array of objects (or arrays) to serialize.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-csv forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the csv pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
